criteria.criterion: A test in athena-git builds a planning snapshot of a fixture repository with several commits, including one touching records/ and one touching a private path. It checks that the history file exists with one entry per commit (subject, date, changed paths), is capped at 200 commits, and contains no records/ or private path. Run: cargo test -p athena-git snapshot.
criteria.evidence: Ran: 14 passed, including a_history_snapshot_lists_visible_commits_without_hidden_paths_or_a_repository and a_history_snapshot_is_capped_at_the_limit_counted_after_exclusion. Read the tests. The fixture has records-only, private-only (private/ is athena-exclude), mixed and visible commits. The tests assert the exact list of subjects, a 10-char date, and the visible paths. They assert that 'records', 'private', FRONT.md and again.md never appear. With 205 visible commits plus records commits, the file has exactly 200 entries, newest first.

criteria.criterion: The snapshot contains no .git directory and the user's repository is unchanged by snapshotting. A test checks this. Run: cargo test -p athena-git snapshot.
criteria.evidence: The same history test asserts !snap.dir().join(".git").exists(). It also compares repo_state (status --porcelain, HEAD, for-each-ref, .git/config) before and after: equal. The test passed.

criteria.criterion: A briefs test shows planner_brief and critic_brief each name the history file's path and say what it holds (last 200 commits, subject, date, changed paths, records/ and private excluded) and that Read and Grep are used on it. Run: cargo test -p athena-context briefs.
criteria.evidence: planner_and_critic_briefs_name_the_history_file_and_say_what_it_holds passed. Within the History file section of both briefs, it checks for HISTORY_FILE, 'last 200 commits', 'short hash', 'date', 'subject', 'changed paths', '`records/`', 'private', 'Read and Grep' and 'no git command'.

criteria.criterion: A test in athena-core asserts the planner and critic grants are unchanged: no Bash or git commands, writes false. Run: cargo test -p athena-core.
criteria.evidence: the_planner_and_critic_grant_has_no_bash_no_git_and_no_writes passed. It asserts tools == [Read, Grep, Glob], no Bash, empty commands, writes false and dontAsk. Both the planner and critic paths call planning_grant(); the critic already shared `grant` in the planner flow, per the diff. The full athena-core suite passed within Athena's recorded cargo test --locked.

criteria.criterion: The time the history file adds to snapshotting is measured, and the figure (labeled as a measurement, with the repository and method) is recorded in docs/decisions.md.
criteria.evidence: D134 has 'Time added (measurement)': the median of 9 runs on a 501-commit fixture repository in a debug test build, timed with Instant in a temporary test. Plain copy took 47.1 ms and with history 132.4 ms, so about +85 ms, with min/max given. It states that this repository's own history was unavailable, so it claims no figure for it.

criteria.criterion: CHANGELOG.md has an entry, and docs/decisions.md records the decision. It lists the alternatives (git repository in the snapshot, widened git grants, plain copy), the choice, and cites job 20261024-115923-02gf.
criteria.evidence: There is a CHANGELOG Unreleased/Added entry. D134 lists alternatives (a) a repository in the snapshot, (b) widened git log/show/diff grants and (c) the plain copy, states the decision, and cites job 20261024-115923-02gf.

criteria.criterion: cargo test, cargo clippy --all-targets and cargo fmt --check all pass.

summary: The candidate meets the accepted reading. The planner and critic snapshots are still plain directories with no .git, and now carry a HISTORY.txt file. It lists up to 200 first-parent commits (short hash, date, subject, visible changed paths). Records/ and athena-exclude paths are filtered with the snapshot's existing classify rules. Commits left with no visible path are dropped before the cap is counted. Both briefs describe the file. The grant is now the named function planning_grant(), unchanged and pinned by a test, and a cross-crate test keeps the file-name and limit constants equal. I ran the athena-git snapshot, athena-context briefs and athena-core planning_grant tests, and all passed. The timing figure in D134 is labeled a measurement, but it comes from a fixture, not this repository. fmt, clippy and the full test suite passed in Athena's recorded checks. All changed files are on the deliverables list.
